articles.title: How to Free Up SSD Space for 100 GB Games
articles.excerpt: New games regularly need 100 GB or more on an SSD. How to see what is using your space, move games between drives without re-downloading, and what consoles allow.
articles.hero_image_alt: Storage bar showing a 115 GB game needing free space on an SSD

body.text: Big releases now regularly need more than 100 GB on an SSD. Modern Warfare 4 lists 115 GB and Ace Combat 8 lists 125 GB. The fastest way to make room is to **move games you are not playing to another drive**, which avoids downloading them again later.
First, see what is using the space
**On Windows:** open Settings, then System, then Storage. Windows shows how much space apps, temporary files and other categories are using.
**On Steam:** open Settings, then Storage. You get a list of installed games on each drive, sorted by size.
Start with the largest items. Removing one 100 GB game you finished months ago does more than an hour of clearing small files.
Move games to another drive
In Steam's Storage settings you can select installed games and **move them to another drive** without re-downloading. You can add a second drive there as a new library location first.
The Xbox app on PC also lets you choose which drive a game installs to, and move installed games between drives.
Keep in mind:

items: **Games that require an SSD should stay on an SSD.** Moving one to a hard drive can cause long loads and stutter, or stop it from running.
**Older and smaller games are good candidates** for a hard drive.

body.text: Uninstall what you are not playing
Your purchases stay in your library, and cloud saves keep your progress for games that support them. Check that a game shows cloud saves before removing it if the save matters to you.
Clear temporary files
In Windows Storage settings, open **Temporary files** and remove what you do not need. Read the list before confirming: the Downloads folder can appear there, and you may not want it emptied.
PlayStation 5

items: **PS5 games must run from the console's internal SSD or an M.2 SSD** installed in the expansion slot.
A USB extended storage drive can **store** PS5 games to free up space, but they have to be moved back before you can play them.
PS4 games can be played directly from USB extended storage.

body.text: Xbox Series X|S

items: Games optimized for Series X|S must run from the **internal SSD or a Storage Expansion Card**.
A USB drive can **store** those games, and can run older Xbox One, Xbox 360 and original Xbox games directly.

body.text: How much free space to aim for
Keep more free than the install size. Launchers need working room while unpacking and patching, and updates for large games are often tens of gigabytes.
If you are preparing for a specific launch, read [how preloading works on each platform](/install/how-game-preloading-works).
Quick answers
Can I move a Steam game without downloading it again?
Yes. Use Settings, then Storage, select the game and move it to another drive.
Can I run PS5 games from a USB drive?
No. You can store them there, but they run only from the internal SSD or an M.2 SSD.
Will uninstalling a game delete my save?
Not if the game uses cloud saves and they have synced. Check before uninstalling.

articles.title: How Game Preloading Works on Steam, Xbox, PlayStation and Battle.net
articles.excerpt: Preloading lets you download a game before release so it is ready at unlock. How it works on each platform, and why a preloaded game still needs time on launch day.
articles.hero_image_alt: Diagram of a game download finishing before release day and unlocking at launch

body.text: Preloading means downloading a game's files before its release date, so the game is ready to start when it unlocks. You usually need to have bought or pre-ordered the game, or have a subscription that includes it.
What preloading does and does not do

items: **It downloads the files early.** The large download happens days before launch, not at the moment everyone else starts.
**It does not let you play early.** The files stay locked until the official unlock time.
**It may not be the final version.** Many games get a day-one patch, so expect another download at launch.

body.text: Steam
When a publisher opens preloading, the install button appears on the game's page in your Library. The files are downloaded in an encrypted form.
At release, Steam has to **decrypt and unpack** those files before the game will start. On a slow drive this can take a while for a 100 GB game, so do not expect to be playing in the first minute.
Not every Steam game offers a preload. It is the publisher's choice.
Xbox consoles and the Xbox app on PC
Xbox calls this **pre-install**. It is available for pre-ordered games and for many upcoming Game Pass games.
Find the game in the Store or the Game Pass section and choose to pre-install it. You can also start the download remotely from the Xbox mobile app.
PlayStation 5
On PS5, pre-ordered digital games can **pre-download automatically** shortly before release. In many cases this starts about two days ahead.
For it to work without you touching the console, automatic downloads need to be enabled and the console needs to stay in rest mode with an internet connection.
Battle.net
In the Battle.net app, a pre-load option appears on the game's page once the publisher opens it. Call of Duty and Blizzard games commonly use this.

Modern Warfare 4 opens PC preloading on October 15, eight days before launch. See [Modern Warfare 4's PC requirements, preload time and install size](/requirements/modern-warfare-4-pc-requirements-preload).
Before you preload

items: **Check free space first.** A download fails or pauses if the drive fills up. Some launchers also need extra temporary space while unpacking.
**Install to an SSD when the game requires one.** Many new games do.
**Use a wired connection for very large games** if you can.

body.text: If you are short on space, read [how to free up SSD space for large games](/guides/free-up-ssd-space-for-large-games).
Quick answers
Can I play a preloaded game early?
No. The files unlock at the official release time.
Why is my preloaded game still installing on launch day?
The launcher has to decrypt and unpack the files, and there may be a day-one patch.
Do all games offer preloading?
No. The publisher decides whether to offer it and when it starts.

articles.title: Enshrouded 1.0 Release Date and Platforms: PC and PS5 First, Xbox Later
articles.excerpt: Enshrouded leaves early access on October 15, 2026 on PC and PS5. The Xbox version follows in spring 2027. What changed during early access.

body.text: **Enshrouded version 1.0 launches on October 15, 2026 on PC and PlayStation 5.** The Xbox version has been pushed to **spring 2027**. Developer Keen Games has had the game in Steam Early Access since January 24, 2024.
At a glance
If you already own it on Steam
Version 1.0 arrives as an update to the game you already have. You do not need to buy it again.
Before October 15, it is worth doing two things:

items: **Back up your saves.** Large updates can change how worlds and characters are stored.
**Check the developer's 1.0 notes for save compatibility.** We have not seen Keen Games confirm how existing early access worlds carry over, so do not assume either way.

body.text: What was added during early access
Wccftech's report lists the major additions the game received on the way to 1.0:

items: New regions: Blackmire swamp, Albaneve Summits and Veilwater Basin
Hollow Halls dungeons
Voxel water simulation, with fishing
Animal husbandry
An Adventure Sharing portal for community maps
Combat changes, including dual-wield daggers and reworked greatswords
Gear reinforcement with attribute runes
Individual quest progression in co-op
A cosmetic transmog layer
Playable instruments

body.text: The report does not separate which features are new in 1.0 from those that arrived in earlier updates.
Xbox players have to wait
The Xbox version is now expected in spring 2027, months after the PC and PS5 launch. No exact date has been given.
Still to be confirmed

rows: Save compatibility with early access worlds

body.text: We will update this page as Keen Games confirms each one.
Sources

items: [Wccftech, Enshrouded 1.0 launch date for PC and PS5, Xbox in spring 2027](https://wccftech.com/enshrouded-october-15-1-0-pc-ps5-xbox-spring-2027/)

articles.title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Install Size and PC Requirements
articles.excerpt: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve needs 125 GB on an SSD and Windows 11 on PC. Minimum and recommended specs, what the targets mean, and Denuvo status.
articles.hero_image_alt: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve official screenshot

body.text: **Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve needs 125 GB of storage on an SSD**, and the PC version lists **Windows 11** as its only supported operating system. The game released on October 2, 2026 for PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
At a glance
PC system requirements
These are Bandai Namco's official PC specs, as reported by DSOGaming.
What these targets mean
Two details are easy to miss:

items: **Both targets use upscaling.** The recommended tier is 1080p at 60 FPS on Medium with an upscaler turned on. It is not a native 1080p target, and no official tier is given for 1440p or 4K.
**32 GB of RAM is recommended.** That is double what most 2026 releases ask for. With 16 GB you meet the minimum tier, which targets 30 FPS on Low.

body.text: If your PC sits between the two tiers, expect to mix Low and Medium settings to hold 60 FPS.
Windows 10 is not listed

Both tiers list Windows 11 64-bit only. Bandai Namco has not listed Windows 10 as supported, so Windows 10 players should treat the game as unsupported on their system until the publisher says otherwise.
Storage: plan for more than 125 GB
The game must be installed on an SSD. Keep extra room free for patches and shader data on top of the 125 GB install.

If you need to make space, our guide covers [how to free up SSD space for large games](/guides/free-up-ssd-space-for-large-games), including moving other games to a second drive without re-downloading them.
Quick answers
How big is Ace Combat 8 on PC?
125 GB, on an SSD.
Does Ace Combat 8 run on Windows 10?
Only Windows 11 is listed in the official requirements.
Does Ace Combat 8 use Denuvo?
Yes, according to DSOGaming's report on the official specs.
How much RAM does Ace Combat 8 need?
16 GB minimum and 32 GB recommended.
Sources

items: [DSOGaming, Ace Combat 8 official PC requirements and Denuvo](https://www.dsogaming.com/news/ace-combat-8-wings-of-theve-gets-official-pc-requirements-will-have-denuvo/)

articles.title: How to Check TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot on Windows Before a Game Launch
articles.excerpt: Some PC games now require TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot. Check both in two minutes with built-in Windows tools, and what to do if either one is off.
articles.hero_image_alt: Checklist showing TPM 2.0, UEFI mode and Secure Boot as the three things to check

body.text: Some PC games refuse to start unless **TPM 2.0** and **Secure Boot** are enabled, because their anti-cheat relies on them. You can check both in about two minutes with tools already built into Windows.
Modern Warfare 4 is one example. See its [PC requirements, preload time and install size](/requirements/modern-warfare-4-pc-requirements-preload).
Check TPM 2.0

items: Press **Windows + R**, type **tpm.msc** and press Enter.
Look at **Status**. It should say the TPM is ready for use.
Look at **Specification Version** under TPM Manufacturer Information. It should say **2.0**.

body.text: If the window says a compatible TPM cannot be found, the TPM is most likely switched off in your motherboard settings. That is common on PCs built by their owners.
Check Secure Boot

items: Press **Windows + R**, type **msinfo32** and press Enter.
Find **BIOS Mode**. It should say **UEFI**.
Find **Secure Boot State**. It should say **On**.

body.text: What your results mean

rows: Turn on Secure Boot in your firmware settings.
Turn on the firmware TPM in your firmware settings.
Your Windows drive needs converting first. See below.

body.text: Turning them on

Both settings live in your motherboard's firmware settings, often still called the BIOS. You reach them by pressing a key such as Delete or F2 while the PC starts. The exact menu names differ between manufacturers.

items: **TPM:** on Intel systems the setting is usually called **PTT** (Platform Trust Technology). On AMD systems it is usually called **fTPM**.
**Secure Boot:** usually found under a Boot or Security menu.

body.text: Change one setting at a time and check that Windows still starts normally.
If BIOS Mode says Legacy
Secure Boot needs UEFI mode, and UEFI needs your Windows drive to use the GPT partition style. A PC in Legacy mode usually has an MBR drive.
Windows includes a tool called **MBR2GPT** that can convert the drive without erasing it, but this is the one step here that can stop Windows from starting if it goes wrong.

items: **Back up your important files first.**
Follow Microsoft's own instructions for MBR2GPT and for your motherboard.
If you are not comfortable with this, ask someone who is. Do not rush it on launch day.

body.text: Do this before launch day
Check now, not when the game unlocks. Changing firmware settings is quick when it goes well and slow when it does not, and launch day is a bad time to find out.
Quick answers
How do I know if I have TPM 2.0?
Run tpm.msc and check that Specification Version says 2.0.
Is it safe to turn on Secure Boot?
On a PC already in UEFI mode it is normally a simple switch. On a PC in Legacy mode you need to convert the drive first, so back up before you start.
Will enabling TPM slow down my games?
No. It is a security feature and does not change game performance.

articles.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Release Date, Editions and PC Requirements
articles.excerpt: Star Wars: Galactic Racer launches October 6, 2026. Standard is $59.99, Deluxe is $79.99, and the PC version needs 50 GB on an SSD. Full details here.
articles.hero_image_alt: Star Wars: Galactic Racer official screenshot
articles.hero_image_caption: Image: Fuse Games, Secret Mode / Steam

body.text: **Star Wars: Galactic Racer launches on October 6, 2026.** On Steam the Standard Edition costs **$59.99** and the Deluxe Edition costs **$79.99**, and the PC version needs **50 GB on an SSD**.
At a glance
Editions and prices
The Steam listing does not mention early access for either edition. Prices vary by region, so check your local store.
Pre-purchase bonus
Pre-purchasing either edition adds an exclusive repulsorcraft livery and an exclusive multiplayer player banner.
Minimum PC requirements
From the game's Steam page:
The recommended tier is listed on the Steam page too. Check it there before buying if you plan to play above 1080p.

At 50 GB this is one of the smaller big releases this month. Modern Warfare 4 needs 115 GB and Ace Combat 8 needs 125 GB. See our pages on [Modern Warfare 4's PC requirements and preload](/requirements/modern-warfare-4-pc-requirements-preload) and [Ace Combat 8's install size](/install/ace-combat-8-install-size-pc-requirements).
DRM: Denuvo with an activation limit
The Steam page lists **Denuvo Anti-Tamper with a 5 machine activation limit**. That matters if you often switch between several PCs or reinstall Windows regularly.
Quick answers
When does Star Wars: Galactic Racer come out?
October 6, 2026.
How much is Star Wars: Galactic Racer?
$59.99 for Standard and $79.99 for Deluxe on Steam in the US.
How big is Star Wars: Galactic Racer on PC?
50 GB, and an SSD is required.
Does it have cross-play?
The Steam page lists cross-platform multiplayer.
Sources

items: [Steam store page, Star Wars: Galactic Racer](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078430/STAR_WARS_Galactic_Racer/)

articles.title: Modern Warfare 4 PC Requirements, Preload Time and Install Size
articles.excerpt: Modern Warfare 4 needs 115 GB of SSD space, TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot on PC. PC preload starts October 15 and the game launches October 23, 2026.
articles.hero_image_alt: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 official screenshot

body.text: **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23, 2026**, and PC preloading opens on **October 15 at 9:00 AM PT**. On PC you need **115 GB of SSD space**, and the game will not start unless **TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot** are enabled.
Key dates

rows: PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2

body.text: 9:00 AM PT is 12:00 PM ET, 5:00 PM in the UK and 9:00 PM in Pakistan.
PC system requirements
These are the three tiers Activision published for PC, as reported by TalkEsport.

rows: RX 6600 XT / RTX 3060 Ti / Arc B580

body.text: The minimum tier is low for a 2026 release: a GTX 970 and 8 GB of RAM. The ray tracing tier is a large step up, with 32 GB of RAM and a 16 GB graphics card.
TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are required

Modern Warfare 4 requires **TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot** to be enabled on PC, and your CPU must support AVX. Most PCs built in the last several years have both features, but they are often switched off in the motherboard settings.

Check this before launch day, because turning Secure Boot on can involve changing firmware settings. Our guide shows [how to check TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot on Windows](/guides/check-tpm-secure-boot-windows) in two minutes.
Install size and storage
All three tiers list **115 GB on an SSD**. A hard drive is not supported.

items: Leave more than 115 GB free. Updates and shader data need working room.
If you are short on space, see [how to free up SSD space for large games](/guides/free-up-ssd-space-for-large-games).
Console install sizes have not been listed in the PC specs.

body.text: How preloading works for this launch

Preloading downloads the game files ahead of release so you can play as soon as it unlocks. On PC it opens October 15, eight days before launch. Digital pre-purchase players also get the campaign on October 16.
If you have not preloaded a game before, read [how preloading works on Steam, Xbox, PlayStation and Battle.net](/install/how-game-preloading-works).
PC features
According to the same specs announcement, the PC version includes:

items: More than 800 customization options across graphics, gameplay and interface
Ray tracing across game modes
Multiple upscaling options
An in-game benchmark tool
Shader preloading
HDR10+ Gaming support

body.text: Quick answers
How big is Modern Warfare 4 on PC?
115 GB, and it must be installed on an SSD.
When can I preload Modern Warfare 4 on PC?
From October 15, 2026 at 9:00 AM PT.
Does Modern Warfare 4 need TPM 2.0?
Yes. TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot must both be enabled on PC.
Can a GTX 970 run Modern Warfare 4?
It is listed as a minimum GPU, alongside the RX 470 and Arc A580.
Sources

items: [TalkEsport, Modern Warfare 4 PC specs, features and preload date](https://www.talkesport.com/news/modern-warfare-4-pc-specs-preload-date/)
